name: 结构与假设发现时序工作流
purpose: 完成Step 2后调用结构与假设发现算子，再根据专家提供的现实边界完成Step 3及后续建模。

actions.rule: Complete Steps 1 and 2 and record the problem understanding and modeling assumptions.
Select the highest-priority unresolved structural assumption and apply the referenced operator.
Incorporate relevant advice into the model, validate affected results, and complete Steps 3 through 7.

stop_condition: Stop after completing the model and validating the consultation's downstream effects.
